economy.summary: His candidate profile with the Schuylkill County Democratic Committee says the region's struggles include rising costs and that he will fight for good-paying jobs.
economy.short: Cites rising costs; says he will fight for good-paying jobs.

education.summary: Says he will fight for fair school funding and describes area schools as underfunded; he is a 13-year public school teacher who served two years on the Tri-Valley School Board.
education.short: Supports fair school funding; describes local schools as underfunded.

healthcare.summary: Says he will fight for affordable healthcare and describes healthcare as vanishing in the Coal Region.
healthcare.short: Supports affordable healthcare; says local healthcare is vanishing.

guns.summary: Says he will fight for protection of Second Amendment rights. The same profile says he opposes a proposed 7,500-bed ICE facility that he says threatens to overwhelm Tremont's water, sewer, and emergency systems.
guns.short: Supports Second Amendment rights; opposes proposed Tremont ICE facility.

economy.summary: Her official House member website lists restoring the economy and energizing small business among her legislative priorities; the site does not detail specific proposals.
economy.short: Lists restoring economy, energizing small business among priorities.

taxes.summary: Called property taxes one of the biggest challenges facing her community and co-hosted a March 2026 town hall with Republican colleagues on solutions for easing the school property tax burden on homeowners and businesses.
taxes.short: Calls property taxes major challenge; co-hosted tax-relief town hall.

abortion.summary: Voted against House Bill 1957 in December 2025, a proposed amendment to the Pennsylvania Constitution providing for personal reproductive liberty that would have created a state constitutional right covering reproductive decisions including abortion; the measure passed the House 102-101.
abortion.short: Voted against proposed reproductive-liberty state constitutional amendment.

education.summary: Joined a joint statement condemning Penn State's plan that could close the Penn State Schuylkill campus, saying the campus gives students access to education close to home, and pledged to work with fellow lawmakers to keep it open.
education.short: Opposes Penn State Schuylkill closure; pledged to keep campus open.

guns.summary: Voted against House Bill 714 in May 2023, a bill to require background checks on firearm sales in Pennsylvania including private sales of long guns; the bill passed the House 109-92.
guns.short: Voted against bill expanding firearm background-check requirements.
